raw:
I remember working a final shift with a coworker who was retiring. I keep track of stock at a bookstore, and there was a farewell card beside the till. What really stayed with me was her unpinning her name tag from her apron. It was such a small thing, but seeing it come off made it feel final.

I felt sad thinking that we wouldn’t be working together anymore. I was happy for her, too, but that didn’t quite take away the sadness. The card beside the till and that name tag coming off are the things I remember most clearly.
